title: PMFBY Farmers Insurance Coverage Analysis
description: District-level SQL analysis of India's PMFBY crop insurance data to measure farmer coverage, premium contribution splits, and regional coverage gaps.
metric: 1,800+ district-year records analyzed, Built 26+ Advanced SQL Queries Across Multiple Concepts
insights: Medium-Scale Farmers Contributed the Largest Share of Premium Volume
District-level analysis revealed uneven insurance penetration, with some districts showing substantially lower coverage rates despite similar agricultural activity.
Premium Collection and Insurance Coverage Were Not Uniformly Correlated Across Districts, Indicating Potential Gaps in Outreach or Affordability.
